observation_operator: finite-volume top-hat reconstruction of SLABx section averages

findings.axis_attribution: downwind-only marginal clipping at ignition; crosswind and height marginal clipping are zero
findings.packet_support: effective top-hat packet support is approximately 426324 m downwind at ignition, while the configured downwind domain is 162 m wide
findings.early_onset: downwind clipping is already present at 1e-6 s, so simply extending the far-downwind boundary does not close the packet

interpretation: The liquid-pool SLABx carrier section has an extremely small H2 mass fraction for this small event. Converting the finite emitted inventory to one rectangular section therefore creates a very long packet. The result is preserved as outside-domain mass and remains withheld from flammable mass, blast, and facility QRA. A provider-resolved spatial envelope or a validated liquid-pool observation operator is required before promotion.
